payload._note: AdaptHealth Corp. is a home medical equipment (HME) provider, not a healthcare operator with Medicare-certified provider facilities. The filing states the company services approximately 4.1 million patients annually across all 50 states through a network of approximately 680 locations in 47 states as of December 31, 2023. However, these are retail/distribution locations (typically ~5,000 sq ft office/warehouse space) for delivering medical equipment and supplies directly to patients' homes, not provider facilities like skilled nursing facilities or hospitals that would have Medicare CCNs. The company leases all properties and does not own any. The filing contains no CCNs or facility rosters because AdaptHealth operates as a durable medical equipment supplier, not as a licensed healthcare provider operating certified facilities. The 680 locations are billing/distribution centers for equipment rental and supply sales, not patient care facilities requiring Medicare certification.
